title: Requires the State Court Administrator to study civil proceedings and submit findings to the interim committees of the Legislative Assembly related to the judiciary not later than September 15, 2026.
headline: HB 2489 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2489 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
